onboarding.title: Create your workspace
onboarding.description: Your matters, court days and people live in a workspace. You can belong to several and switch any time.

kindHint.solo: Your own practice. Invite juniors or clerks later if you need to.
kindHint.chamber: A shared workspace for an advocate's chamber, with seats for each member.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the workspace.
errors.nameInvalid: Use a name with at least one letter or digit.
errors.offline: You are offline. Connect to create a workspace.
errors.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.generic: Could not create the workspace. Please try again.

welcome.title: Set up {workspace}
welcome.clerkIntro: You are setting this practice up for your senior. Do the three steps, then ask for their approval.

language.title: Choose your language
language.body: The whole app switches to the language you pick.

import.title: Bring in the cases
import.body: Import the diary from a photo, a file or WhatsApp, then confirm the listings it finds.

today.title: See the court day
today.body: Check today’s listings and where each item stands.

approval.title: Your senior’s approval
approval.body: When the setup looks right, ask your senior to approve it. They need one tap.
approval.pending: Waiting for your senior. Ask them to open {path} and tap Approve.

senior.title: Clerk setups waiting for you
senior.empty: No clerk setup is waiting for approval.
senior.item: {name} has finished setting up the practice.

welcome.notForRole: This page is for clerks, and for the people who run the practice.
